description: A ladder on a 5-high pillar: sprint along the wall into the ladder's edge; sprint into its face and climb to the top; sneak back to the top edge, then walk off. A vine on another pillar: walk into it, climb, climb holding only jump, slide, hold on sneaking, slide down.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
